correctness.rationale: For all finite tournaments U of order at least two, N+(C3[U]) is the union of three contractible cones K_i=N+(U)_i * Delta(B_{i+1}). Their geometric consecutive intersections are precisely N+(U) blocks and the triple geometric intersection is empty (the abstract empty face is not a geometric point). Cofibration homotopy-colimit replacement yields a three-edge loop and reduced suspensions at the edges, so N+(C3[U]) ≃ S1∨(vee^3 Sigma N+(U)), including disconnected N+(U). As N+(C3) is three isolated points, the base suspension supplies six loops plus one outer loop, giving 7 circles at k=2; induction gives 3^(j-1) spheres in lower degree j<=k-2 and 7*3^(k-2) in top degree k-1. Lexicographic outdegree m+(m-1)/2 ensures regularity at all orders 3^k. Finite computations at order 27 check Euler characteristic only, not full homology; the universal proof is the cover and homotopy pushout.
